lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The most anterior line is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the torso. Several posterior lines show fading or discontinuity before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Three distinct high-contrast white spots are visible on the lower haunch, situated superior to the hind limb joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns follow a lyrate trajectory, curving backwards and slightly outwards from the base before turning inwards and upwards at the distal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between terminal tips is approximately 3.8 times the width of an individual horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Ivory-colored tipping accounts for approximately 15-20% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp white transverse chevron is visible on the bridge of the muzzle. The distal limbs feature high-contrast ochre coloration beginning below the carpal and tarsal joints.
